classification.why: candidate change A for the next Phase-3 round: measured offline, implemented behind a default-off switch, not yet run live

what: Probe economics. Measured information gain per probe across the four live legs of 2026-07-31: 56 probes designed, 52 completed, and the hypothesis frontier never shrank once -- zero monotone drops in any leg. 47 of the 52 completed probes landed OFF the frontier (survived == []), meaning the observation matched no hypothesis at all, so the 0.5436-1.0000 bits priced at design time were never realisable. 18 of the 56 designs repeated an experiment already run byte for byte. The existing gate (entropy_bits > 0) said no zero times in four legs. Implemented ProbeEconomy: carry refutations forward so the frontier can shrink, suppress repeat experiments, retire the probe class after 3 consecutive off-frontier results, cap firings per frontier generation. Default off.

switch.default: off -- ProbeEconomyConfig().enabled is False and reproduces 2026-07-31 behaviour
switch.env: THEORIA_PROBE_ECONOMY=1 (positive whitelist; anything unrecognised stays off)
switch.artefact: every leg writes probe_economy.json whether or not the change is on
